==Usage==
<pre>{{GCW
|heading=
|prev=
|row=
|next=
|topics=
}}</pre>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|row}} Name of the corresponding {{Tl|Full Galactic Civil War}} row template, minus (<code><nowiki>GCW </nowiki></code>). For example, "<code>1&nbsp;BBY&nbsp;1</code>" from {{Tl|Full Galactic Civil War/1 BBY 1}}.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|heading}}
**1 = Early Campaigns ([[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]&ndash;[[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]])
**2 = Destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]] and the Yavin blockade ([[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]&ndash;[[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]])
**3 = Alliance on the Run ([[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]&ndash;[[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]])
**4 = Showdown at Endor ([[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]&ndash;[[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]])
**5 = Imperial Fragmentation ([[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]])
**6 = Fall of the Empire ([[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]&ndash;[[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]])
**7 = Thrawn and the Reborn Empire ([[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]&ndash;[[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]])
**8 = The Post-Reborn Empire ([[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]]–[[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]])
**9 = Last Days of War ([[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]]–[[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]])
**0 = Unidentified placement (Alphabetical order)
*{{Para|prev}}
*{{Para|next}}
*{{Para|topics}}

===Example(s)===
<pre>{{GCW
|heading=1
|prev=[[Template:GCW 2 BBY|Early Campaigns]]: [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]
|row=1 BBY 1
|next=[[Fresian campaign]]: [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]
|topics=[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] · [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] · [[Order of the Sith Lords]] · [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]]<br />[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] · [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] · [[Tyber Zann]] · [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] · [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]]
}}</pre>

Results in:

{{GCW
|heading=1
|prev=[[Template:GCW 2 BBY|Early Campaigns]]: [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]
|row=1 BBY 1
|next=[[Fresian campaign]]: [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]
|topics=[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] · [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] · [[Order of the Sith Lords]] · [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]]<br />[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] · [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] · [[Tyber Zann]] · [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] · [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]]
}}
